updates.content:
Reason for Outage: Cable Break

Our technicians are currently tracing dead feeders along the affected fibre route and working to reduce the high fibre loss levels impacting services in the area. Technicians remain on site and are addressing faults as they are identified. Restoration efforts are currently underway.

Reason for Outage: Cable Damage
Upington is currently experiencing a network service outage. We apologise for this drop in connection. Evotel technicians are on site implementing repairs.
